blurb: Guests paddle and portage from lake to lake in the BWCA and Quetico Park wilderness, exploring historic routes and enjoying wildlife and fishing. Complete outfitting includes choice of canoe style, generous food supplies, and all camping equipment. Orientation and trip routing are provided at the downtown Ely outfitting base before departure.
extraNote: Downtown Ely outfitting base located on Ely’s main street, across from the city park
